tagline.en: Excursions, activities and private transfers from Agadir
tagline.fr: Excursions, activités et transferts privés depuis Agadir

description.en: A local Agadir team that arranges day excursions, activities and private transfers across southern Morocco. Send your request on WhatsApp: no online payment, no prepayment.
description.fr: Une équipe locale d'Agadir qui organise des excursions à la journée, des activités et des transferts privés dans le sud du Maroc. Envoyez votre demande sur WhatsApp : pas de paiement en ligne, pas d'acompte.

currency.note: Rate of 10 matches the client's own catalogue (EUR 20 = about 200 MAD). Review quarterly. Always show the unit (per person / per vehicle / per group) next to every price.

legal.note: Do not use the words 'organise', 'our tours' or 'our vehicles' in public copy until the licence type and transport authorisations are confirmed by a Moroccan lawyer.

trust.note: Only verified numbers and real third-party reviews. Nothing invented. No AggregateRating markup until real reviews exist.

pickupZones.rule: Hotel lobby or nearest agreed meeting point. Exact time confirmed on WhatsApp the evening before. Farther zones are picked up earlier.

vehicles.label: Private van
vehicles.luggage: one suitcase per passenger plus cabin bag

vehicles.luggage: one suitcase per passenger plus cabin bag

Scenic and photo stops on the route

payment.method: Cash to the driver or host at pickup, or on completion for transfers
payment.confirmNote: Confirm acceptance of EUR cash with the accountant and issue a receipt for every booking.

privateDayRates.includes: Driver, fuel, tolls and parking; up to 10 hours

rates.label: Paradise Valley, Massa and Tiznit, Taroudant and Tiout (full day)

text.en: Free cancellation or date change up to 24 hours before pickup. Just tell us on WhatsApp. Late cancellations and no-shows are recorded, and we may ask for advance payment on future requests. If we cancel because of weather, safety or a minimum group not being reached, we will offer another date, an alternative activity, or a full refund of anything already paid.
text.fr: Annulation ou changement de date gratuit jusqu'à 24 heures avant la prise en charge. Il suffit de nous prévenir sur WhatsApp. Les annulations tardives et les absences sont enregistrées et nous pouvons demander un paiement à l'avance pour les demandes futures. Si nous annulons pour cause de météo, de sécurité ou de groupe minimum non atteint, nous proposons une autre date, une activité de remplacement ou le remboursement intégral de toute somme déjà versée.

text.en: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup. Weather and sea conditions can change plans: if we cancel for safety reasons we reschedule or refund. Guests must follow the safety briefing. Age, weight and health restrictions apply and are confirmed when you request.
text.fr: Annulation gratuite jusqu'à 24 heures avant la prise en charge. La météo et l'état de la mer peuvent modifier le programme : si nous annulons pour des raisons de sécurité, nous reportons ou remboursons. Les participants doivent respecter le briefing de sécurité. Des restrictions d'âge, de poids et de santé s'appliquent et sont confirmées lors de votre demande.

text.en: Free cancellation or change up to 12 hours before pickup. For arrivals we track your flight and wait up to 60 minutes after landing at no charge; longer waits are charged per additional 30 minutes. If you cannot find your driver, message us on WhatsApp straight away.
text.fr: Annulation ou modification gratuite jusqu'à 12 heures avant la prise en charge. Pour les arrivées, nous suivons votre vol et attendons jusqu'à 60 minutes après l'atterrissage sans frais ; les attentes plus longues sont facturées par tranche de 30 minutes. Si vous ne trouvez pas votre chauffeur, écrivez-nous immédiatement sur WhatsApp.

text.en: Children under 4 travel free (no guaranteed seat in shared vehicles, please tell us in advance). Children aged 4 to 11 pay the child price. Child seats for transfers on request with advance notice.
text.fr: Les enfants de moins de 4 ans voyagent gratuitement (place non garantie dans les véhicules partagés, merci de nous prévenir à l'avance). Les enfants de 4 à 11 ans paient le tarif enfant. Sièges enfant pour les transferts sur demande, avec préavis.

text.en: Please be ready 5 minutes before the confirmed pickup time. Drivers wait up to 10 minutes at hotel pickups; if we cannot reach you we may have to leave to protect the other guests' day.
text.fr: Merci d'être prêt 5 minutes avant l'heure de prise en charge confirmée. Les chauffeurs attendent jusqu'à 10 minutes aux prises en charge d'hôtel ; si nous ne parvenons pas à vous joindre, nous devrons peut-être partir pour ne pas pénaliser les autres clients.

adventureStandard.en: Every quad, buggy, horse-riding and boat activity starts with a safety briefing. Helmets and safety equipment are provided where the activity requires them. Guests with heart conditions, back problems or pregnancy should not take part in quad, buggy or horse-riding activities. Minimum ages and weight limits are set by each operator and confirmed before you go.

faq.a: Send us a request on WhatsApp with the activity, date, number of guests and your hotel. We check availability and confirm the details and the price in the same chat. There is no online payment and no prepayment.
No. You pay in cash to the driver or host at pickup (or on completion for transfers).

faq.q: Where do you pick me up?
faq.a: From your hotel or a nearby meeting point in Agadir, Anza, Tamraght, Aourir and Taghazout. The cruise port is available on request.
We confirm your exact pickup time on WhatsApp the evening before. It depends on your hotel zone and the activity.
Yes on most trips. Children under 4 travel free and ages 4 to 11 pay a child price. Quad, buggy and horse riding have minimum ages that we confirm when you ask.

faq.q: Can I book a private tour or vehicle?
faq.a: Yes. Any excursion can be done privately with your own vehicle and driver. Ask us on WhatsApp for the private rate.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Boat trips, dune activities and quad rides can be cancelled or moved for safety. We will offer another date, an alternative or a full refund of anything already paid.

faq.q: What should I wear or bring?
faq.a: Comfortable shoes, sun protection and water. For villages and medinas, light clothing that covers shoulders and knees is more comfortable and respectful. Each trip page lists what to bring.

faq.q: Can you collect me from the airport at any hour?
faq.a: Yes, arrival transfers run 24/7 by prior arrangement. We track your flight and the driver waits for you in the arrivals hall.
Schedules can change during Ramadan and some evening activities may not run. Message us for the current programme.

seasonalNotes: Summer (June to September): very hot inland. Marrakech and Taroudant days start early. Bring water and sun protection.
Winter (December to February): mild days, cool mornings in the mountains. Rough seas can cancel boat trips.
Ramadan: schedules shift and evening shows or some activities may not run. Confirm each year.
Eid and school holidays: very high demand, encourage early requests.

greeting.en: Hello and welcome to {brand}! Tell us which activity or transfer you are interested in, your date, number of guests and hotel, and we will confirm availability shortly.
greeting.fr: Bonjour et bienvenue chez {brand} ! Dites-nous quelle excursion, activité ou quel transfert vous intéresse, la date, le nombre de personnes et votre hôtel, et nous vous confirmons la disponibilité rapidement.

away.en: Thanks for your message. Our team is offline right now (we reply 08:00 to 22:00, Morocco time). We will answer first thing in the morning.
away.fr: Merci pour votre message. Notre équipe est actuellement hors ligne (nous répondons de 08h00 à 22h00, heure du Maroc). Nous vous répondrons dès demain matin.

confirmation.en: Confirmed: {product} on {date}. Guests: {pax}. Pickup: {hotel} at {time}. Price: {amount} {currency} ({unit}), payable in cash at pickup. Free cancellation until {deadline}. Ref: {ref}. Please reply YES to confirm.
confirmation.fr: Confirmé : {product} le {date}. Personnes : {pax}. Prise en charge : {hotel} à {time}. Prix : {amount} {currency} ({unit}), à régler en espèces sur place. Annulation gratuite jusqu'à {deadline}. Réf. : {ref}. Répondez OUI pour confirmer.

reminderExcursion.en: Reminder for tomorrow: {product}. Pickup at {time} from {hotel}. Your driver: {driverName}, {vehicle}, plate {plate}, phone {driverPhone}. Please be ready 5 minutes early.
reminderExcursion.fr: Rappel pour demain : {product}. Prise en charge à {time} à {hotel}. Votre chauffeur : {driverName}, {vehicle}, plaque {plate}, tél. {driverPhone}. Merci d'être prêt 5 minutes à l'avance.

reminderArrivalTransfer.en: Your arrival transfer: flight {flight}, landing {time}. Your driver waits in the arrivals hall holding a sign with your name. Driver: {driverName}, {vehicle}, {driverPhone}. If you cannot find us, message us here right away.
reminderArrivalTransfer.fr: Votre transfert à l'arrivée : vol {flight}, atterrissage {time}. Votre chauffeur vous attend dans le hall d'arrivée avec une pancarte à votre nom. Chauffeur : {driverName}, {vehicle}, {driverPhone}. Si vous ne nous trouvez pas, écrivez-nous ici immédiatement.

cancellationAck.en: Thanks for letting us know. Your booking {ref} is cancelled at no charge. We would be happy to help you find another date.
cancellationAck.fr: Merci de nous avoir prévenus. Votre réservation {ref} est annulée sans frais. Nous serons ravis de vous aider à trouver une autre date.

reviewRequest.en: Thank you for travelling with us! If you enjoyed it, a short Google review helps a small local team a lot: {reviewLink}
reviewRequest.fr: Merci d'avoir voyagé avec nous ! Si vous avez apprécié, un court avis Google aide beaucoup une petite équipe locale : {reviewLink}

whatsappRequestMessage.en: Hello, I would like to check availability for {product} on {date} for {guests} guests. Hotel: {hotel}. Language: {lang}. Ref: {ref}
whatsappRequestMessage.fr: Bonjour, je voudrais vérifier la disponibilité pour {product} le {date} pour {guests} personnes. Hôtel : {hotel}. Langue : {lang}. Réf. : {ref}

contentRules: Never call the Massa/Tiznit coastal dunes 'Sahara'. They are small coastal dunes.
Goats in argan trees are seasonal and never guaranteed. Never promise them.
Present Essaouira as a historic Atlantic port city (Mogador), not as an imperial city.
No 'best', '#1' or 'cheapest' claims. No years-in-business, customer counts or ratings until verified.
Do not say 'guide' or 'professional guide' until guide credentials are confirmed. Use 'driver' and 'host'.
Always show the unit next to a price (per person / per vehicle / per group).
Use 'Request' or 'Check availability' wording, not 'Book now', until licence and confirmation flow are settled.
Do not publish entrance fees (Majorelle, Crocoparc, etc.) unless confirmed on the day of publishing.
launchBlockers: Real brand name and domain (brand.placeholder = true)
Travel-agent licence type and number verified
Tourist transport authorisations confirmed for every vehicle used
Insurance certificates (passenger liability and activity cover) and safety statement
Owner confirmation of every price, unit and included/excluded item (all currently draft)
Owner confirmation of cancellation, payment and children policies
Real photos and video, with rights
Native French review of all French copy
Moroccan lawyer review of terms and of what may be published before licence
Confirmation of guide credentials, or removal of any guide claim
